meta_title: Fresho Alternative for Food Distributors in 2026
meta_desc: Keep Fresho running and add one spoken step: kitchens say the order into an app and confirm each line. A Fresho alternative you add rather than adopt.

hero.h1: The Fresho Alternative You Add Alongside Fresho.
hero.lead: VoiceOrder Solutions gives your phone accounts a voice app, and everything else keeps running. Accounts talk through what they need in the app and look the lines over before sending, and each order lands in a format you take today. Your Fresho setup, from OrderPilot to the full suite, carries on.

stats.label: Returns to the day on each phoned order
Brings the first order from most kitchens

problem.h2: Why distributors weigh an alternative to Fresho
problem.lead: Looking up a Fresho competitor is seldom a complaint about the product. Fresho is an order and operations system with real depth in fresh food. The search usually comes down to scope or sequence, and neither one needs Fresho taken out.

cards.h3: Fresho can already run most of the operation
cards.body: Fresho reaches from the order through to the payment, and their pricing lets you take only the parts you want. How much of the operation sits with one vendor is a big decision. How some accounts place their order is a small one, and it can be answered on its own.

cards.h3: Some kitchens would change the habit
cards.body: Their AI is built so a customer need not change a thing, which is a deliberate choice and a sound one, and for plenty of accounts it is right. A few would still rather say it once and see the lines than leave one more voicemail for a machine to read.

cards.h3: A voice step does not wait on a rollout
cards.body: Fresho publishes its timeline openly: around four weeks to set up, plus two to four weeks training the AI. Putting our app in front of some accounts is a separate decision, and it can happen in either order.

features.h2: The one step a Fresho alternative adds

rows.h3: The habit moves, and that is the point
rows.body: A chef walks the cooler, says what is short, and the lines come up from that account's guide. They fix anything off and send. It is a change in how they order, and because they fixed the lines themselves, nobody at your end has to rebuild the order afterwards.
bullets: They see the list before a thing is sent
Done in the cooler or at the desk, at any hour
Their own handset, iOS or Android, nothing issued
20 to 30 minutes back against the same order by phone
Interrupted halfway? It holds the order until they come back

rows.h3: Narrow on purpose: your lines, your figures
rows.body: Each account gets the items it buys at the price you hold for it, against your own codes. That guide is the whole of our setup.
bullets: Lines drawn from the account's own guide
Pricing and the catalog remain yours to control
Change a guide once and the next order carries it
Begin on a handful of accounts and judge it there

rows.h3: It lands where your paperwork already starts
rows.body: A finished order arrives as an email carrying a PDF, Excel or Word file, or goes straight into your ERP over the API, over EDI, or into QuickBooks. Whatever sends your invoices and plans your runs today goes on doing it.
bullets: Sent to a named rep, or to the purchasing desk
On a direct feed nobody retypes it at your end
Carrying a number, with the date and time of sending
No module of yours has to be switched off

rows.h3: Stock in the frame as orders come through
rows.body: VoiceOrder Solutions carries real-time inventory visibility tied to order activity, and the catalog updates as stock levels change. It is not the system of record for stock: whatever you run today keeps that role, and a demo shows how the levels connect.
bullets: Over the full catalog, not only the quick movers
Fewer stockout surprises on a late, heavy order
Levels come out of whatever you count with now
Counting and buying stay with your own system

cards.h2: Fresho runs the day, VoiceOrder Solutions adds the voice
cards.lead: This is a sensible pairing rather than a standoff. We are not a Fresho replacement: some accounts change how they order, and everything after that order, the picking and the run and the invoice, is left as it is. A Fresho alternative quite often means precisely this.

items.h3: The back end keeps every job it has
items.body: Invoices, payments, pick lists and the delivery run are not on offer here and are not touched. We hand the completed order over, and the rest of the day stays yours.

items.h3: Let every account pick its route
items.body: Customers happy in the portal, or happy leaving a voicemail for OrderPilot, carry on just as Fresho promises. Hand the app to the kitchens that would rather talk it through and check it on screen.
No modules to choose and nothing to decommission. Open a few of the accounts that cost you the most time and decide on the evidence.

midcta.h3: Watch one account place a spoken reorder
midcta.body: Twenty minutes. One account, a single order spoken aloud, and the rest of your operation never moves.

steps.h2: Three steps, and no modules to pick
steps.lead: There is nothing to scope. You pass us the guides, we load them and set up each account, and your customers get going.

items.body: A spreadsheet covers it. Items and the price per account go into one admin screen, under the codes you already use.
We provision each customer and the kitchen downloads the app. Most will have ordered before the day is finished.
Confirmed by the buyer, numbered and timed, in whichever of your formats you chose.

comparison.h2: Fresho, plus a voice reorder. Their depth, one step added.
comparison.lead: Two columns, one operation: as it runs now, and with spoken orders added for the accounts that want them. Fresho covers ordering, stock, margins, delivery, picking, invoicing and payments, and it knows produce, meat and seafood properly, so a Fresho alternative is rarely the right word for what you need. The two products do not connect.

items.q: Is a Fresho alternative what we actually need?
items.a: Usually not. Fresho is an operations system built for perishable wholesale, from the order to the payment, and replacing it to change how a few kitchens order would be out of scale. Keep it, and bring in VoiceOrder Solutions for the kitchens happier talking than typing.

items.q: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than Fresho?
items.a: At delivery runs, invoicing, taking payment, picking, margin control or reporting, not remotely: we do none of them. Where we help is narrower, a kitchen that speaks its order and checks every item before it sends. That runs alongside everything Fresho does rather than competing with it.

items.q: Their AI handles voicemails. Do we need yours too?
items.a: Maybe not for every account, and it is worth being exact because both products involve a voice. Theirs reads a voicemail your customer already left and works the order out of it. Ours has the customer speak into an app that builds the lines from their guide, which they then confirm. That difference, not a missing feature, is why a Fresho alternative search sometimes ends with both.

items.q: Does VoiceOrder Solutions connect to Fresho?
items.a: No. Nothing connects the two, and neither company supports the other. Both sit beside your ERP on their own terms: theirs through its own ERP connection, ours by email, EDI, API or QuickBooks. Neither one passes orders to the other.

items.q: Do our customers have to change what they do?
items.a: Only the ones you choose. OrderPilot's published promise is that customers carry on ordering exactly as they always have, and the Fresho portal is there too. Let each account pick: our app suits the kitchens that prefer to talk. One limit: a call or a voicemail to your desk gets no number, no timestamp and nothing moving against stock from us. Only what comes through our app does.

items.q: How fast could this be running?
items.a: For most distributors this takes 24 to 48 hours, and most kitchens have ordered by the end of day one. There are no modules to scope, and nothing in Fresho changes while the first accounts start.

They are the most open about this of anyone we look at: a published starting figure, a setup fee, worked examples and a calculator, with prices by region. We publish nothing and give you a quote instead. Since Fresho stays, ask us to quote just our part.

items.q: Where do the Fresho details on this page come from?
items.a: Read off fresho.com as it stood on 10 October 2026: the modules they list, the order automation description, the category guides and the pricing page. Their saving figures and review scores belong to them and are not repeated here as results. If any of it has changed, the mistake is at our end.

mainCta.h2: Fix the front door, leave the rest
mainCta.body: Twenty minutes and one voice order, from the kitchen to your desk.
